newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The governemnt on Tuesday announced the discovery of a new mine of high quaity coal in Northern Dinajpur district.
The move to use private equipment for cargo handling in the Chittagong Port was foiled on Tuesday in the face of resistance by workers' unions.
Outlawed political groups killed over 500 people in 10 southwestern districts last year, police said.
Saudi Arabian authorities have deported 931 Bangladeshis for staying there illegally.
The government on Tuesday directed the law-enforcing agencies to go for stern action against underground political activities in the country's southwestern region.
Some noted citizens at a discusson in Dhaka on Tuesday viewed the proposed sub-regional grouping of four south Asian countries as detrimental to the SAARC.

Bangladeshi consumers are going to have the opportunity to buy stereo-look colour television at extremely cheap prices when the Rangs Group starts marketing the Indian BPL colour TVs in the local market.
Country's sugar mills are facing scarcity of sugarcane.
